title: Yellow Trident
description: A resource pack that makes the trident yellow
body:
This resource pack makes the trident yellow, similar to the yellow trident often held by the BSD Daemon, sometimes known as Beastie.

Features:

+ Changed trident item texture (used in inventory)
+ Changed trident texture when being held/thrown
+ Changed trident particles

You may also want to check out [my other similar resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/silver-trident).
